Since HPAC is the target of both Paeonianin E and Nordextrorphan, it is plausible that Stellettin C exerts its effect through a similar mechanism, influencing the same transporter and thereby affecting HPAC. The scores from the two paths indicate a moderate level of confidence in this relationship, suggesting that Stellettin C may act as a modulator of HPAC through its interaction with the H(+)/Cl(-) exchange transporter 3. The evidence supports a mechanistic link between Stellettin C and HPAC, though further experimental validation would be necessary to confirm the direct interaction and functional role.
